independent_event_oracle: YAML 1.2.2 specification (§10.3.2 Core Schema, §7.3.2 Single-Quoted Style) cross-checked against libyaml event stream
cannot_use_independent_json_reason: The event stream (structure, !minidump tag, scalar styles, and exact raw texts) comes independently from libyaml and YAML 1.2.2, and the hex integers (0x0000399E = 14750, 0x00007FFEFB76A9B8 = 140733117278648, 0x00007FFEFB76A000 = 140733117276160, 0x00007FFEFB76B000 = 140733117280256, 0x00007FFEFB76C000 = 140733117284352) and single-quoted string follow YAML 1.2.2 §10.3.2 / §7.3.2. However, the .json golden cannot be produced purely by a generic JSON/libyaml oracle for three documented reasons: (1) JSON has no native tag syntax for !minidump (encoded as {"!minidump": ...}); (2) standard 64-bit JSON parsers such as serde_json::Value cannot represent the 105-bit exact integer 30044000000000000000000000000000 as an exact integer; and (3) overflowing decimal integers past 128 bits (3004400000000000000000000000000000000000 -> 3.0044e+39) to finite f64 and preserving multi-digit leading-zero decimals (0000000000000000) as strings to avoid legacy octal ambiguity are documented ayaml default-profile rules (docs/compatibility.md).
